--- QUERY 0 (params=None) ---
SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY

--- QUERY 1 (params=(['clarityit', 'clarityit_admin', 'clarityit_app', 'clarityit_migrator', 'clarityit_owner'],)) ---
SELECT rolname, rolsuper, rolinherit, rolcreaterole, rolcreatedb, rolcanlogin, rolreplication, rolbypassrls FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = ANY(%s) ORDER BY rolname

--- QUERY 2 (params=(['clarityit', 'clarityit_admin', 'clarityit_app', 'clarityit_migrator', 'clarityit_owner'], ['clarityit', 'clarityit_admin', 'clarityit_app', 'clarityit_migrator', 'clarityit_owner'])) ---
SELECT member.rolname, granted.rolname, am.admin_option, am.inherit_option, am.set_option FROM pg_auth_members am JOIN pg_roles member ON member.oid = am.member JOIN pg_roles granted ON granted.oid = am.roleid WHERE member.rolname = ANY(%s) AND granted.rolname = ANY(%s) ORDER BY 1,2

--- QUERY 3 (params=[['public', 'platform']]) ---

        SELECT n.nspname, c.relname, c.relkind, c.relpersistence,
               pg_catalog.format_type(c.reltype, NULL)
        FROM pg_class c
        JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
        WHERE n.nspname = ANY(%s)
          AND c.relkind IN ('r','v','m','S','f','p')
        ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relkind, c.relname;
        

--- QUERY 4 (params=[['public', 'platform']]) ---

        SELECT n.nspname, c.relname, a.attnum, a.attname,
               pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod),
               a.attnotnull, pg_get_expr(d.adbin, d.adrelid), a.attidentity
        FROM pg_attribute a
        JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = a.attrelid
        JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
        LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid = a.attrelid AND d.adnum = a.attnum
        WHERE n.nspname = ANY(%s) AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
          AND c.relkind IN ('r','v','m','f','p')
        ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, a.attnum;
        

--- QUERY 5 (params=[['public', 'platform']]) ---

        SELECT n.nspname, c.relname, con.conname, con.contype,
               pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid, true)
        FROM pg_constraint con
        JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = con.conrelid
        JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
        WHERE n.nspname = ANY(%s)
        ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, con.contype, con.conname;
        

--- QUERY 6 (params=[['public', 'platform']]) ---

        SELECT n.nspname, c.relname, i.relname,
               pg_get_indexdef(ix.indexrelid, 0, true),
               ix.indisunique, ix.indisprimary
        FROM pg_index ix
        JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = ix.indrelid
        JOIN pg_class i ON i.oid = ix.indexrelid
        JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
        WHERE n.nspname = ANY(%s)
        ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, i.relname;
        

--- QUERY 7 (params=[['public', 'platform']]) ---

        SELECT n.nspname, c.relname, t.tgname, pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid, true)
        FROM pg_trigger t
        JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid
        JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
        WHERE n.nspname = ANY(%s) AND NOT t.tgisinternal
        ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, t.tgname;
        

--- QUERY 8 (params=[['public', 'platform']]) ---

        SELECT n.nspname, c.relname,
               s.seqtypid::regtype, s.seqstart, s.seqincrement,
               s.seqmax, s.seqmin, s.seqcache, s.seqcycle
        FROM pg_class c
        JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
        JOIN pg_sequence s ON s.seqrelid = c.oid
        WHERE n.nspname = ANY(%s) AND c.relkind = 'S'
        ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname;
        

--- QUERY 9 (params=[['public', 'platform']]) ---

        SELECT n.nspname, p.proname,
               pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid),
               pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)
        FROM pg_proc p
        JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
        WHERE n.nspname = ANY(%s) AND p.prokind IN ('f','p','w')
        ORDER BY n.nspname, p.proname,
                 pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid);

--- QUERY 11 (params=None) ---
SELECT n.nspname, p.proname, pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid), pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee), a.privilege_type, a.is_grantable FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace, aclexplode(coalesce(p.proacl, acldefault('f', p.proowner))) a WHERE ((n.nspname = 'public' AND p.proname = 'normalize_user_email' AND pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) = '') OR (n.nspname = 'platform' AND p.proname = 'reject_reconciliation_mutation' AND pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) = '') OR (n.nspname = 'public' AND p.proname = 'prevent_bootstrap_unlock' AND pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) = '') OR (n.nspname = 'public' AND p.proname = 'normalize_team_slug' AND pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) = '') OR (n.nspname = 'public' AND p.proname = 'kc_search_vector_update' AND pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) = '') OR (n.nspname = 'public' AND p.proname = 'adoc_set_updated_at' AND pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) = '') OR (n.nspname = 'public' AND p.proname = 'ki_set_updated_at' AND pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) = '') OR (n.nspname = 'public' AND p.proname = 'protect_last_team_owner' AND pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) = '') OR (n.nspname = 'platform' AND p.proname = 'protect_succeeded_revision' AND pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) = '') OR (n.nspname = 'public' AND p.proname = 'set_updated_at' AND pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) = '') OR (n.nspname = 'public' AND p.proname = 'trg_artifacts_updated_at' AND pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) = '') OR (n.nspname = 'public' AND p.proname = 'ki_search_vector_update' AND pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) = '')) AND p.prokind IN ('f','p','w') AND pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) IN ('clarityit_app','clarityit_admin','PUBLIC','clarityit','clarityit_migrator','clarityit_owner') ORDER BY 1,2,3,4,5

--- QUERY 12 (params=None) ---
SELECT n.nspname, pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee), a.privilege_type, a.is_grantable FROM pg_namespace n, aclexplode(n.nspacl) a WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','platform') AND pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) IN ('clarityit_app','clarityit_admin','PUBLIC','clarityit','clarityit_migrator','clarityit_owner') ORDER BY 1,2,3

--- QUERY 13 (params=None) ---
SELECT pg_get_userbyid(datdba) FROM pg_database WHERE datname = current_database()

--- QUERY 14 (params=None) ---
SELECT n.nspname, pg_get_userbyid(n.nspowner) FROM pg_namespace n WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','platform') ORDER BY 1

--- QUERY 15 (params=None) ---
SELECT n.nspname, c.relname, c.relkind, pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','platform') AND c.relkind IN ('r','S','i','v','m','f','p') ORDER BY 1,2,3

--- QUERY 16 (params=None) ---
SELECT n.nspname, p.proname, pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid), pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','platform') AND p.prokind IN ('f','p','w') ORDER BY 1,2,3

--- QUERY 17 (params=None) ---
SELECT pg_get_userbyid(d.defaclrole), n.nspname, d.defaclobjtype, pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee), a.privilege_type FROM pg_default_acl d LEFT JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = d.defaclnamespace, aclexplode(d.defaclacl) a WHERE pg_get_userbyid(d.defaclrole) IN ('clarityit_owner') AND n.nspname IN ('public','platform') ORDER BY 1,2,3,4,5

--- QUERY 18 (params=None) ---
SELECT e.extname, pg_get_userbyid(e.extowner) FROM pg_extension e WHERE e.extname IN ('pgcrypto','citext','pg_trgm') ORDER BY 1
